meta.name: India's Got Latent
meta.description: India's Got Latent is an Indian Hindi comedy talent show hosted by Samay Raina on YouTube. Inspired by the international Got Talent franchise and Kill Tony, it features a wide variety of acts including singing, dancing, magic, and comedy.

videos.title: Episode 1 : Ft. Alia Bhatt, Sharvari Wagh & Aashish Solanki
videos.overview: Guest judges Alia Bhatt, Sharvari Wagh & Aashish Solanki join the panel as singers, comedians and impersonators compete on stage.

videos.title: Episode 2 : Ft. Chandan Prabhakar, Kiku Sharda & Harssh Limbachiyaa
videos.overview: Guest judges Kiku Sharda, Chandan Prabhakar and Harssh Limbachiyaa join Samay as contestants showcase musical performances and variety acts.

videos.title: Episode 3 : Ft. Vishal Dadlani, Raghu Ram, Tanmay Bhat & Yashraj
videos.overview: Tanmay Bhat, Raghu Ram, Vishal Dadlani and Yashraj join Samay as performers bring comedy, jump rope acrobatics and mimicry to the stage.

videos.title: Episode 4 : Ft. Karan Aujla, Tanmay Bhat, Rahul Dua & Gurleen Pannu
videos.overview: Contestants showcase live music, parody songs and martial arts performances before guest judges Tanmay Bhat, Gurleen Pannu, Rahul Dua and Karan Aujla.

videos.title: Episode 5 : Ft. Orry, Archana Puran Singh, Sharon Verma & Nishant Suri
videos.overview: Orry, Archana Puran Singh, Nishant Suri and Sharon Verma join Samay for a lively mix of Punjabi music, classical dance and rap performances.

videos.title: Episode 6 : Ft. Rakhi Sawant, Ashneer Grover & Kushagra Srivastava
videos.overview: Contestants showcase their talents in guitar performance, stand-up comedy, robotics, karate, belly dancing, and mentalism before guest judges Rakhi Sawant, Ashneer Grover, and Kushagra Srivastava.

videos.title: Episode 7 : Ft. Nawazuddin Siddiqui, Bhuvan Bam, Mukesh Chhabra, Kaustubh Agarwal
videos.overview: Bhuvan Bam, Nawazuddin Siddiqui, Mukesh Chhabra and Kaustubh Agarwal join Samay as magic, music and mimicry take the stage.

videos.title: Episode 8 : Ft. MC Stan, Tanmay Bhat, Madhur Virli, Arpit Bala
videos.overview: Contestants showcase dance, music, puppet performances & mimicry before guest judges MC Stan, Tanmay Bhat, Madhur Virli and Arpit Bala.

videos.title: Episode 9 : Ft. Raftaar, Balraj Ghai, Sahil Kale
videos.overview: The OGs are back! Season one's fan favorites return for a special episode with Raftaar, Sahil Kale, Balraj Ghai and Samay.
